question.rationale: The current best model v3_r1 contains odd functions of x and an input-driven trace, so from reset it predicts polarity-reversed inputs will produce polarity-reversed output trajectories. The earlier polarity result supports this symmetry only for its tested schedules and was for v3_r0, not the current model; test the structural prediction on new schedules. Held-out failures for v3_r0 also caution against treating its fit as settled.
question.claim: For reset trials described by v3_r1, reversing the complete input schedule should reverse the output trajectory, including on schedules outside those previously observed.
question.update_if_violated: If polarity-paired trajectories depart from sign-reversed outputs beyond measurement-noise expectations, revise or reject the odd-symmetry relation for v3_r1 and fit candidate symmetry-breaking terms against held-out complete trajectories.
